mentions.name: Ledgee
mentions.description: A minimal iOS expense tracker for fast manual transaction entry: enter amount, tap category, and it's saved with no save button, forms, or subscriptions. Includes a simple overview and a ledger, with data syncing via iCloud for automatic backup.
mentions.audience: Tried many finance apps that felt too heavy; mainly wanted the fastest possible way to record a transaction before forgetting it.
mentions.source_excerpt: I recently built a small iOS expense tracker called Ledgee.
